# betterado_storage_key (Data Source)

Gets the storage key (UUID) for an Azure DevOps object by its descriptor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "MyProject"
}

# Get the project descriptor first.
data "betterado_descriptor" "project" {
  storage_key = data.betterado_project.example.id
}

# Resolve the storage key (UUID) from a descriptor.
data "betterado_storage_key" "project" {
  descriptor = data.betterado_descriptor.project.descriptor
}

output "storage_key" {
  value = data.betterado_storage_key.project.storage_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `descriptor` (String) The descriptor of the Azure DevOps object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The storage key UUID (used as the data source ID).
- `storage_key` (String) The storage key (UUID) for the Azure DevOps object.
